name: veil
description: Veil — an open-source, self-hostable privacy identity manager: masked email/phone aliases, disposable personas, encrypted vault + sync, TOTP, and breach monitoring.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @veil/web" "npm run dev -w @veil/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @veil/web && npm run build -w @veil/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @veil/web && npm run typecheck -w @veil/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @veil/web && npm run test -w @veil/server
